title: Identity presentation film

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Connect a visual system to its subject and uses, because a collection of attractive assets alone does not explain why they belong together.
strategic_value: The progression from natural movement to circular letters and real applications can make the Museum’s catalyst ambition tangible.
demonstration: The one-minute film moves through natural footage, concentric letter and word patterns, color groupings, signage, campaigns, website layouts and the final identity. The PNG preserves its published title poster.
practical_value: Trace how the same circular vocabulary connects nature imagery, identity and application.

content_islands.name: Nature and language
content_islands.spec: Begin with moving natural imagery and curved phrases.

content_islands.name: System demonstration
content_islands.spec: Show expanding letter rings, colors and specimen compositions.

content_islands.name: Applications
content_islands.spec: Sequence signage, printed and digital examples before returning to the symbol.

reference_purposes.Expression: The one-minute film moves through natural footage, concentric letter and word patterns, color groupings, signage, campaigns, website layouts and the final identity. The PNG preserves its published title poster.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram describes the identity’s strategic shift from passive catalogue to active catalyst and the aim to create advocates for the planet.
